tests.reason: Every write path (claims, the DM, the push) writes to the shared production database, so it cannot run on staging (CLAUDE.md rules 31-32, 48); the staging gateway refuses the tick outright (409). The suite proves the behaviour over an in-memory database with a fake clock: Mariia/Jovana/Alex once each on three different days, send-once across retries, no retroactive sends, strict exclusion, closed pilot, shadow writes nothing, locale gate. The SQL of the claim RPCs is proven on PGlite: docs/validation/VTID-05205/outputs/pglite-welcome-team-check.txt.
